靈魂從不需要討好、追逐或證明: The soul never needs to please, chase or prove.
所以當你很想要被愛、被認可、變有錢、很成功: So when you badly want to be loved, recognized, rich or successful,
那通常不是靈魂的渴望，而是你還有一塊頻率尚未穩定: it's usually not your soul's longing. It's a part of your frequency that isn't steady yet.
宇宙才讓你「渴望那個外界」，來引導你看見內在的頻率缺口: That's why the universe lets you long for something out there: to lead you to see the frequency gap within.
